第72届美国编剧工会奖(2020)
　　电影奖 最佳纪录片剧本(提名) 马克·乔纳森·哈里斯

writer.name: 马克·乔纳森·哈里斯 Mark Jonathan Harris

director.name: 马克·乔纳森·哈里斯 Mark Jonathan Harris

introduction: Oscar®-winning filmmakers Deborah Oppenheimer and Mark Jonathan Harris (Into the Arms of Strangers: Stories of the Kindertransport) reunite for a revealing first-hand look at the foster care system as seen through the eyes of those who know it best. With extraordinary access to the inner workings of the Los Angeles County Department of Children and Family Services (DCFS), Oppenheimer and Harris go beyond the sensational headlines and stereotypes to take an unprecedented look at an often misunderstood world and upend some of the most enduring myths about foster care and those involved in the system.
